messages:
Alex Chen: Heads up — Nimbus Analytics wants an 18‑month commit. They asked for 50% annual upfront, split invoice between EU/US entities, then net90 on the remainder. POC must start after initial invoice is paid. Can we get deal-desk + finance signoff?
Maria Lopez: POC scope ready on our side. We'll need DPA/SOC2 before any Prod data. Technical kickoff can be Tue 4/7 if payment cleared.
Jordan Kim: Need the quote and rate card reference. We typically avoid net90. Who is the authorizing signatory on the customer side?
Alex Chen: Quote id Q-2026-089 in Drive (link shared in email). Customer procurement says CFO will sign; they prefer bank transfer to EU entity. Discount requested is 20% off list for the POC + commit.
Priya Singh: Net90 is a credit risk. Finance requires either a larger upfront deposit or completed credit app + internal approval. If they want net90 we usually ask for 70% upfront or a guarantor.
Sam Patel: From an operational POV we can start POC after payment receipt. Alternative compromises: 30% upfront + monthly invoices (net30) for remainder, or 40% upfront + net90 but with credit check.
Jordan Kim: Please post the numbers (list price, discounted total, ARR, payment cadence). We'll need a short justification to route to approvals. Also flag any special billing entity mapping.
Alex Chen: Numbers: list annual = $525,000; 20% discount -> $420,000 ARR. 18mo total = $630,000 pre-discount, post-discount =~ $504,000. Customer wants 50% upfront for year1, then net90 for rest.
Tara O'Neal: Legal notes — split invoicing is OK if each invoice ties to the legal entity's PO. We need the SOW to say: "POC kickoff contingent on receipt of initial payment". No special changes to indemnity. DPA must be attached.
Nimbus CFO: Our procurement standard is Net90. We can agree to 50% initial for year1. Need invoices to map to our EU and US subsidiaries for VAT and internal cost centers.
Jordan Kim: Deal desk suggestion: 35% upfront, remainder net60, billing split by entity. That reduces credit exposure and keeps the customer happy. Need credit app + PO before we finalize.
Priya Singh: Finance proposal: approve contingent on completed credit application and PO mapping; if credit app not provided, require 50% upfront. Also require wiring instructions and EU bank details up front.
Sam Patel: Technical ask — include milestone in SOW: "POC starts on payment receipt, deliverables X/Y within 30 days" so we can schedule infra.
Alex Chen: Customer verbally agrees to 35% upfront + rest net60 if we accept split invoicing. Will request the signed PO today.
Jordan Kim: Deal desk pre-approves 35% upfront + net60 contingent on credit app + PO. Apply SKU RDW-ENTERPRISE-1 at 30% commit discount (cap as discussed). Document justification in the deal desk thread.
Tara O'Neal: Legal OK to proceed with that route. I will draft the SOW language and attach DPA. Need invoice entity mapping from customer before signature.
Priya Singh: Finance: final approval pending credit app + PO. Once received we'll provision billing and set payment reminders (Net60).
Alex Chen: I'll email customer with terms and attach SOW draft + credit app. Updating thread when PO lands. Thanks all :tada:
BillingBot: Reminder — when PO/credit app received, tag @Finance and set billing schedule in Zuora.
Alex Chen: Confirmed — customer says PO will be sent by end of day. If PO misses EOD, we'll revert to 50% upfront.
Jordan Kim: Noted. Add one more control: if payment not received within 14 days of PO, do not start POC.
Alex Chen: Agreed, I'll include that clause in the SOW.
```Invoice terms:
 - Upfront: 35%
 - Balance: Net60
 - Billing entities: US / EU (split per PO)
 - Quote: Q-2026-089
 - SKU: RDW-ENTERPRISE-1
```
Alex Chen: Updated — PO arrived and is mapped to EU/US entities. Sending to finance for credit app check and final sign-off.
Priya Singh: Credit app received. Finance signs off. Processed in billing system, set schedule to Net60.
Jordan Kim: Deal desk final sign-off recorded. Proceed to contracting. :thumbsup:
